judged.rule: The narration-only continuity check passes: the viewer keeps one role from hook to closing, and every lo/gua/dia, speaker change and instruction recipient resolves from speech alone.
The opening is a specific recognizable moment with a question the episode answers, entered differently from recent episodes on this board.
Early in the narration the concept is spoken by its English name, then its Indonesian meaning, then a plain explanation.
Explanation and scene-based discussion carry roughly half the narration, followed by one concrete application and a closing answer to the opening question.
Exactly two frames use the charcoal palette, each on a dramatic script line, with background, text, captions and chrome inverting together.
Every frame develops through several meaningful visual changes (three to five as a starting guide) beyond text entrances and caption updates.
Series chrome keeps its geometry across shots and palette changes, and key content stays inside x88–936 / y230–1480.
Emphasis copy stays short (zero to five words as a guide), no paragraph restates the narration, and captions carry every spoken word.
